title: Measuring Memory and Generalization as Separable Geometric Channels: The Topo^2 Framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.30487v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep networks trained on noisy labels simultaneously generalize on clean data and memorize flipped labels. These are usually conflated as pressures on one capacity. We present Topo^2, a measurement framework that makes them causally separable, measurable, and law-governed. Persistent-homology H1 structure of the representation space separates into a within-class manifold channel (a function of the training stopping point) and a cross-class channel (a monotone readout of memorized flipped samples). An intervention, the FM0 prescription (zero loss on flipped samples from epoch 0), reaches each setting's generalization ceiling while memorizing essentially nothing. Within the framework we establish a law set with graded evidence: (L2) FM0 separation prescription (9/9); (L1) the within-channel as a training-position function (mid-rise 6/6; convergence-back CIFAR 3/3, SVHN 2/3); (L3) a ring-construction identity (definitional, not a law); an

translated_title: 将记忆与泛化作为可分离的几何通道进行测量：Topo² 框架
translated_abstract: 在噪声标签上训练的深度网络会同时在干净数据上泛化并记忆被翻转的标签，这两者通常被混为一谈，被视为对同一容量的竞争性压力。我们提出了 Topo²，一个使二者在因果上可分离、可测量且受规律支配的测量框架。表示空间的持续同调 H1 结构可分离为类内流形通道（它是训练停止点的函数）和跨类通道（它是对被记忆的翻转样本的单调读出）。作为一种干预手段，FM0 处方（从第 0 个 epoch 起对翻转样本施加零损失）在几乎不记忆任何内容的情况下达到了各设置下的泛化上限。在该框架内，我们建立了一套具有分级证据强度的规律集：(L2) FM0 分离处方 (9/9)；(L1) 类内通道作为训练位置的函数（中段上升 6/6；收敛回落现象在 CIFAR 上 3/3，在 SVHN 上 2/3）；(L3) 环构造恒等式（属定义性结果，而非规律）；……
tldr: 提出 Topo² 测量框架，利用持续同调将深度网络对噪声标签的记忆与泛化在几何上分离为两个可测通道，并通过 FM0 干预证明网络可在几乎不记忆翻转标签的情况下达到泛化上限。
en_tdlr: The Topo^2 framework uses persistent homology to causally separate memorization and generalization into two measurable geometric channels in deep networks, and demonstrates via an FM0 intervention that networks can reach the generalization ceiling while memorizing essentially nothing.
